recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, multi-subject group portrait of five men with voluminous 1980s hairstyles, wearing dark leather and denim, set against a gritty, textured background. The composition is anchored by a geometric shield-shaped logo at the top and a thin border framing the entire image.
coreVisualRelationships: Overlapping subjects creating a sense of depth and camaraderie
Contrast between high-volume hair textures and smooth leather surfaces
Geometric logo framing the primary band name against organic human forms
Low-key lighting emphasizing facial contours and dramatic expressions
coreInvariants: Dark, textured clothing like leather jackets with zippers
A thin, single-line border framing the composition
A top-aligned graphic shield containing the primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects arranged in a triangular cluster, filling the frame from chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the top-aligned shield logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top logo, moves down through the central figure, then circles clockwise through the surrounding band members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with subjects and texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in clothing and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and golden-blonde hair highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red and light blue within the graphic shield logo.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with low overall saturation, giving a gritty, film-like quality.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or vibrant modern colors
Limit to earth tones, blacks, and desaturated primary accents

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; focus on the blocky, geometric stability of the characters

composition.position: Top center within a shield graphic
composition.overlap: Contained within a white rectangular bar
composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the background and top of the subjects

composition.overlap: Overlays the bottom of the subjects

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, blocky display face for the brand name paired with a lighter, spaced-out sans-serif for the secondary title.
graphicDevices: Thin rectangular frame around the entire composition
White horizontal bar containing the main text

preserve: Extended width of the main font

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical, and blocky 80s aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary horizontal weight and square-ish curves.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of five men with 1980s glam rock hairstyles, wearing black leather jackets and denim. Use a gritty, grainy film texture and low-key lighting. The background should be a dark, mottled grey stone or concrete. Add a thin brown border around the edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a geometric shield logo at the top center with a white bar across it. Inside the bar, place the main title in a black, extra-extended bold sans-serif. At the bottom center, add the subtitle in a small, white, widely-spaced sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the main font sufficiently wide and blocky?
Is the hair volume consistent with 80s glam rock styles?
Is the lighting dramatic and high-contrast?
Is the shield logo centered at the top?

adjustableVariables: Specific colors in the shield logo
mustRedesign: Modern clean digital photography (must be grainy/analog)
Flat, minimalist vector icons (must be 80s graphic style)
Modern slim-fit clothing (must be bulky 80s leather/denim)

avoid: Modern sans-serif fonts like Helvetica or Arial

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern technology is visible
Check that the text is perfectly centered within the graphic elements
Verify the grain does not obscure facial features
Confirm the border is thin and consistent on all sides
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a gritty multi-subject portrait with a top-heavy geometric logo and a thin frame to replicate the 80s rock album aesthetic.
